sections.content:
Population change in Redditch in 2032

The population in Redditch is projected to increase from 87,129 people in 2022 to 88,279 people in 2032.

Despite an overall increase in the population, there is projected to be a fall in net cross-border migration, which will decrease the population by 807 people.

This is different to the majority of areas in England, where net internal migration is projected to be the biggest factor in population change.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Redditch
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Redditch, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More births than deaths mean that the population is projected to increase by 255, with 8,717 births and 8,462 deaths in Redditch between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would increase the population in Redditch by 0.3%, compared with an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to increase the population by 804, with 35,014 people moving to the area and 34,210 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Redditch by 0.9%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to reduce the population by 807, with 928 people moving to the area and 1,735 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Redditch by 0.9%.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 772, with 3,862 people moving to the area and 3,090 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Redditch by 0.9%, compared with an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Redditch in 2032

The median age in Redditch is projected to rise from 40 years in 2022 to 42 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 20% of the population in Redditch are projected to be aged 65 years or over, up from 18% in 2022.

sections.title: The 80 to 89 age group are set to see the largest change in Redditch between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Redditch is projected to stay the same, at around 63%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 284 to 290 over the same time period.

This is around average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Redditch?

In 2032, 21% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 23% in 2022.

This is above average for England in 2032 (20%).

Looking at the youngest age groups in Redditch between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will fall from 6% to 5%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 9% to 8%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will stay around the same, at 8%
